title: The dev bar is a chat log now, and I have stopped touching it

text:
Each of my responses is one compact card, time and title, oldest at the top. Click a card and it takes over the dev bar's body, with the tab strip left alone. Back returns you to the log.
Nothing is ever redrawn while you read, and it only follows the newest card if you are already at the bottom.
The churn you saw was two of us editing the dev bar at once: me and the minion building the chat tab. I told the minion to build in new files and touch the live ones once, at the end. I am not editing the dev bar again.
